2121962051262087425.en_summary: ACInvestorBlog: $ETH.X Ethereum shows a nearly identical short-term setup as Bitcoin. Ethereum printed a sharp flush overnight toward the $1,712 area (the major horizontal support), then staged a clear reactive bounce. Price is currently trading back in the mid-$1,830s after that low. Daily RSI sits at 26.20, firmly in oversold territory the same stretched condition that favors short-term mean-reversion moves even while the higher-timeframe structure stays under pressure. Whether that bounce sustains or simply sets up another lower high will depend on how price behaves once it approaches the $2000 area and whether the $1,710–$1,720 zone continues to hold.
2121962051262087425.zh_summary: ACInvestorBlog：$ETH.X 以太坊顯示與比特幣幾乎相同的短期設置。以太坊夜間急跌至 1712 美元區域（主要水平支撐），然後出現明確的反應性反彈。價格目前在該低點後交易回中 1830 美元。日線 RSI 為 26.20， firmly 在超賣區域，同樣的拉伸狀況有利於短期均值回歸移動，即使更高時間框架結構仍受壓力。反彈是否持續或只是設置另一個更低高點，將取決於價格接近 2000 美元區域時的行為以及 1710–1720 美元區域是否繼續持有。
